dedupe_keys.name: communications authority of kenya quarterly sector statistics reports mobile mobile money fixed bandwidth broadcasting spectrum cybersecurity

description: The Communications Authority of Kenya monitors the communications sector through data that licensed service providers must return each quarter, and publishes a sector statistics report per quarter of the financial year, the latest for the fourth quarter of 2025-2026 released in September 2026. The 31-page report covers mobile subscriptions and penetration, machine-to-machine subscriptions, mobile money services, mobile data and broadband subscriptions and consumption, market shares, mobile devices, domestic and international voice and SMS traffic, roaming, tariffs, mobile revenue and employment; fixed voice traffic, fixed internet subscriptions by technology and by operator; international internet bandwidth and total utilised bandwidth capacity in Gbps; postal and courier volumes; broadcasting subscriptions; frequency spectrum management; .KE domains; and the cybersecurity landscape, with counts of detected cyber threat events. Reports from several years are listed on the page, each about 0.7 to 1.3 MB. Coverage: Kenya, national totals by quarter, some by operator. Format and access: PDF reports, free; no licence is stated, and the authority disclaims liability for operator-supplied figures. Caveats: PDF only, so tables must be extracted; national totals without county detail; operator returns may be revised. Simulation uses: demand, traffic and international bandwidth series for Kenyan telecom and mobile money dependency models, and a quarterly count of cyber threats. Related records: the ISOC study of IXP impact in Kenya and Nigeria covers local traffic exchange; the ITU ICT statistics give comparable national series.
licence: not stated (only a site copyright notice on the provider pages read on 2026-09-28)
